summary: Ryanair filed a Form 6-K furnishing an RNS announcement publicly calling on UK Transport Minister Heidi Alexander to sack Martin Rolfe, CEO of UK NATS air traffic control, citing a September 8, 2026 flight-plan processing failure, the fourth major NATS outage in 2026 and a repeat of the August 2023 incident. Ryanair cites Rolfe's GBP 1.4m annual pay and government's 49% NATS stake. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is involved; this is public advocacy, not a special situation. Watch for political or regulatory pressure on NATS governance, with no arbitrage angle.
